backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining the backend canister with contact message submission, user profile management, and admin-only access control using a MixinAuthorization pattern.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting that the Setter Specific Training card in TrainingPrograms.tsx was updated to use a new volleyball action photo asset.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON file containing one-sentence summaries of each frontend source file for documentation and build planning reference.
frontend/index.css: Base Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens used throughout the app.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell with a root div and module script entry point for the React/Vite app titled 'Volleyball Basic'.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up TanStack Router with five routes (Home, About, Programs, Pricing, Contact) wrapped in a Navigation and Footer layout.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer with brand logo, quick navigation links, and social media icons (WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram) linking to the coach's profiles.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Sticky top navigation bar with logo, desktop nav links with active highlighting, and a mobile hamburger menu with a slide-down panel.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using TanStack Query, reinitializing when the Internet Identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions and status flags. Includes an `InternetIdentityProvider` component that persists identity across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for submitting and fetching contact messages via the canister actor. Uses `useMutation` for submissions and `useQuery` for retrieving all messages.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Google Fonts, sets up Tailwind CSS layers, and defines CSS custom properties for a navy/gold volleyball theme including light and dark mode tokens. Also defines reusable component utility classes like `.btn-primary` and `.section-title`.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with `QueryClientProvider` and `InternetIdentityProvider` into the DOM root.
frontend/src/pages/AboutCoach.tsx: Page component displaying coach Yash Bhardwaj's bio, stats, highlights, and core values with a navy/gold themed layout. Includes a hero section, photo placeholder, and a call-to-action linking to programs.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact page with a validated form that submits messages to the canister via `useSubmitContactMessage`, plus social media links for WhatsApp, Facebook, and Instagram. Displays success/error states after submission.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Homepage featuring a hero banner, program cards grid, and stats section for a volleyball coaching website. Links to programs and contact pages with navy/gold branding.
frontend/src/pages/Pricing.tsx: Renders the Pricing page for Volleyball Basic, displaying a single coaching plan card with inclusions, a WhatsApp CTA, and an FAQ accordion section.
frontend/src/pages/TrainingPrograms.tsx: Renders the Training Programs page listing six volleyball-specific program cards (e.g., Vertical Jump, Setter, Attacker) each with an image, description, and benefits list.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for reading URL query parameters (supporting both standard and hash-based routing), persisting them to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom navy/gold color palettes, Oswald/Inter font families, custom shadows, accordion animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Tracks the overall project state (version 7) for the Volleyball Basic coaching website, documenting architecture, existing features, known issues, and image requirements.
